Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: After WebSurfer correctly identified the museum’s city as Da Nang, the Planner misclassified Da Nang’s region as “Southern Vietnam (Miền Nam; Nam Trung Bộ).” Nam Trung Bộ is the South Central Coast, part of Central Vietnam, not Southern Vietnam. This conflation led to the incorrect final answer instead of the correct region, South Central Coast.
